entities.summary: David Allan Young Jr. was an American entomologist who specialized in the taxonomy of the Cicadellidae and authored a comprehensive treatment of the family with numerous genera and species described and named by him. This work in three parts, Taxonomic Study of the Cicadellinae , covered 292 genera.
